name: task-cli-synthetic-fixtures
goal: Verify task CLI routing with test-owned synthetic workers and keep real provider execution fail-closed.

evidence: Positive CLI fixtures use an explicitly injected in-process synthetic worker; the ordinary CLI separately proves unqualified execution is refused before a provider call. No CLI or environment bypass is added.

Command construction accepts an optional trusted worker object. The ordinary CLI still constructs its real unqualified worker; no external qualification switch was added. Synthetic fixtures use only in-process fake collaborators.

On harbor-mbp-2 at e760429291, both task and analytics E2E files passed: 12 cases. Synthetic workers exercised models, fallback, usage, price estimates and bounce accounting; the ordinary CLI refused unqualified launch before a provider call.
